title: Who the districts pay: contractors named on their returns
question: Which firms do benefit districts name as their highest-paid contractors, and do the same firms serve several districts?
finding: The districts’ returns for tax years 2021 to 2025 name 38 contractors paid $100,000 or more in a year, $101.9 million in all. 5 firms are named by two or more districts: Block by Block (8 districts, $41.7 million); Streetplus (3 districts, $23.2 million); A3 Visual (2 districts, $2.5 million); Nextstreet Cleaning Sanitation Inc (2 districts, $1.8 million); TL Squared LLP (2 districts, $539,063). Street cleaning and ambassador work for most districts is in the hands of a few firms. One district’s own return discloses an insider tie to its contractor: Lower Polk Community Benefit District lists payments of $1.4 million over 3 returns for cleaning and ambassador services to a firm whose chief executive it describes as its own former executive director.
how: The schedule of the five highest-paid independent contractors (Part VII, Section B) on each return of the district organizations identified in the previous screen, latest version of each return. A contractor’s spellings are joined when one begins with the other, when the first fourteen letters differ by a slip, or when one is given as the other’s trade name. “Reported” adds the amounts over every return on file. The last column is what the City’s own payment file shows paid to the same firm directly. The insider tie is read from the return’s schedule of transactions with interested persons (Schedule L).
limits: A return lists only contractors paid more than $100,000 in the year, and only the top five, so smaller and lower-ranked firms are missing. A handful of firms doing the same work for many districts is what a specialised market looks like, and the returns do not say how any contract was awarded. Here the district itself reported the relationship as the tax form requires. What would settle whether a district tested the price: its board minutes approving the contract and any request for proposals.
